description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLanguage class, which models an employee's language skills, including fluency, competency, and comments, within an HR management system. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes methods for accessing and manipulating language data.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguage
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's language proficiency, including fluency, competency, and comments, mapped to the 'hs_hr_emp_language' database table.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this language entry.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with this language entry.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the Language entity associated with this entry.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the Language entity for this entry.

methods.name: setFluency
methods.description: Sets the fluency level, validating against predefined options.

methods.name: setCompetency
methods.description: Sets the competency level, validating against predefined options.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the optional comment about the language skill.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the optional comment about the language skill.
